SCOPE: Build one provider-neutral object-storage port over the existing encrypted R2 configuration and wire the existing generated-asset and authenticated preview paths through that port. Preserve current tenant/model key validation, metadata sanitization, checksum and unknown-persistence semantics. Implement a deterministic local filesystem adapter for source tests and an R2 adapter using the existing signed request contract; do not contact a real bucket. Add bounded delete and retention behavior through the same port. Edit only the named storage abstraction, adapters, generated-media path, preview path, exports and focused tests; do not create a parallel media model.
ACCEPTANCE: One interface must expose put, get-or-range, head and delete with bounded retention semantics. Generated media must write through an injected port. Authenticated preview must read through the port with HEAD and range behavior. Local adapter tests must cover put/get/checksum/size/mime/range/delete/retention/tenant confinement/traversal/mismatch/unknown outcome. R2 adapter tests must mock fetch and cover signing, endpoint, redacted failures and no real bucket contact. Worker/API typechecks and focused tests must pass with real exit codes. Delivery must list changed files, per-file hashes in a manifest, exact commands, EXIT_CODE values, TEST_RESULT and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. Do not claim deployed round-trip or broader STORAGE closure from source tests.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge implementation, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output, real R2 bucket and paths outside COPY_ROOT/DELIVERY_ROOT
sincerely, Codex
